New test_section_one_largest_doses reduces three workers built as whole multiples of the sealed ceiling-level worker (dose is linear in reading minutes): 4x (1,920 minutes, full row including TWA exactly +6 dB), 3x through a partial projection at exactly three quarters of a 1,440-minute shift, and 6x (2,880 minutes at 115.0 dBA, the largest dose section 1 allows). Each worker has its own group. Class swept (derived range extremes): caps at 102,400, 204,800 and 500,000, a cap on the measured dose before projection, a cap on the group mean and a TWA capped at 115 all scored 1 on the returned bytes and are all rejected now. Tests-only.
